title: 白龙鹿绕峰飞渡

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC02 is approved only for pipeline validation. SH03/SH04 have noted Shisilang age drift; future production passes should regenerate if this remains important.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 余下大汉围成一圈，在玉屏峰山门前站住。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 山门被黑衣大汉把守，拓拔野正无计可施；白龙鹿忽然朝西侧山峰奔去，驮着拓拔野穿过陡峭松林登顶。月下两峰相隔，白龙鹿示意要飞渡，拓拔野抱紧它，二者越过云雾深谷，落到玉屏山顶。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 落到玉屏山顶后，一人一鹿短暂大笑休息，再沿石径和山泉向天湖、青帝居所方向前进。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute or empty flute position depending on continuity, relic bundle.
White dragon-deer must remain a friendly mythic mount: white deer body, pearl neck and shoulder scales, pale jade antlers, long white mane, calm intelligent eyes.
Wufeng must remain a plain dark blunt rectangular edgeless black iron object, not a sharp sword.
Yuping Mountain remains four separated peaks, steep stone cliffs, pine forest, bamboo shadows, jade mist, moonlit forbidden quiet.
Black-clad guards stay at the lower gate; Qingdi remains unseen.
Continue from SC02 trespass pressure, but shift the emotional beat to Tuobaye and white dragon-deer solving the access problem together.
localization_rules: All planning text and eventual editing dialogue should be Chinese unless a technical field requires English.
Storyboard prompts may describe Chinese short-drama style, but must request no readable screen text.
I2V prompts must use silent visual generation: no synthesized speech, no captions, no subtitles, no readable signs, no English words.
Chinese dialogue, narration, sound design, and subtitles should be added later in editing.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: experimental_file_ids only while current local backend supports it; otherwise use official T2V smoke tests or switch provider for formal I2V
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.

suggested_shots.title: 守卫封门，白龙鹿转向
suggested_shots.visual_focus: Tuobaye sees the lower gate sealed by black-clad guards; the white dragon-deer turns toward the western peak.

suggested_shots.title: 西峰密林疾奔
suggested_shots.visual_focus: White dragon-deer carries Tuobaye up the steep forested slope, dodging branches and cliff edges under gathering moonlight.

suggested_shots.title: 月下峰顶对望玉屏
suggested_shots.visual_focus: On the small western summit, Tuobaye and the dragon-deer face the separated Yuping peak across a cloud-filled chasm.

suggested_shots.title: 千丈云海一跃
suggested_shots.visual_focus: The dragon-deer accelerates and leaps across the moonlit void, landing on Yuping peak while Tuobaye clings to its neck.
